meta.title: Meridian × Hargrove Partners — getting Mondays back
meta.description: Sales deck from Meridian, a reporting and forecasting platform for professional services firms, to Hargrove Partners: the shift to weekly client reporting, who wins, three obstacles and fixes, a reference customer, a 12-month ROI model, a nine-week plan and a dated next step.

slides.heading: How Hargrove Partners gets its Mondays back.
slides.lead: Two analyst days a week go into reporting. They do not have to.
slides.notes: Open on Hargrove, not on us. Our name does not appear until slide 5.

slides.heading: Clients now expect weekly reporting: 61% of contracts, up from 18%
slides.lead: Source: survey of 300 mid-size professional services firms, Q3 2025.

slides.heading: Firms that automated reporting grew fees 14%; the rest lost margin
slides.left:
Two analyst days a week
Forecast rebuilt Mondays
Margin down 2 points
slides.right:
Packs out by 08:00
Forecast within ±4%
Fees up 14%
slides.notes: Name the losing column first, slowly. Then the winners. Hargrove is in the left column today.

slides.heading: Partners open one live view at 08:00, not a 40-slide pack
slides.lead: Fees, forecast and at-risk clients, already sent to every client.

slides.heading: Three obstacles, and how Meridian removes them
Packs eat 220 analyst hours a year; Meridian builds them overnight
slides.body:
Scheduled, branded client packs.
Analysts review instead of assemble.

slides.heading: CRM and finance disagree on 1 account in 5; Meridian reconciles nightly
slides.body:
One client record across CRM, billing and time.
No more Friday clean-up.

slides.heading: Partners stop rebuilding the forecast every Monday
slides.left:
Spreadsheet from gut feel
±15% miss each quarter
slides.right:
Tied to fee-earner hours
±4% miss, $42,000 of partner time back

slides.heading: A firm like Hargrove cut weekly reporting to 40 minutes

slides.quote: We cut weekly reporting from two days to forty minutes, and partners finally trust the numbers.

slides.heading: Forty firms like Hargrove report on Meridian
Hargrove saves $118,000 a year against a $64,000 subscription
slides.notes: Walk the maths line by line. Payback is about seven months. Offer the model file so their CFO can change the inputs.

slides.heading: Live in nine weeks: first client pack on 9 March
Sign by 18 December and Hargrove gets Mondays back in March
slides.lead: Kickoff on 5 January holds the 9 March go-live.
